note: From the AL-EXP-01 acceptance suite (QA/al-exp-01.cjs) on the editor build named below. Synthetic fixtures only; public-safe.

checks.name: Fixtures: every committed synthetic cartridge, truth file and the panel's embedded cartridge regenerate byte for byte from their seeds
Separation: the generator and oracle import nothing from the editor; the discovery code reads no files and names no fixture answers; the build carries no truth or oracle code
BL01 contract: canonical JSON (sorted keys, integers only) and SHA-256; a valid plan has one hash whatever its key order; 18 invalid or adversarial plans are refused with explicit reasons
Malformed iNES headers (NES 2.0, truncated, trailing data, dirty header tail) are refused and the bytes are left as they were (not repaired)

A01 (unit): header, trainer, vector, out-of-range, duplicate, wrong-expected and plan-protected mutations are refused; a valid PRG+CHR variant is a new array whose SHA-256 equals an independently patched copy; the base is unchanged

A16 (records): a sealed receipt verifies; a changed base hash, variant list, producer or extra field is refused; no receipt can claim independence; a candidate cannot be marked verified or reviewed, or claim independent verification, and a tampered one is refused

A10/A16 (store): one payload per exact content, one causal edge per trial; importing twice adds nothing; an altered payload or forged receipt is refused; the private-class metadata export has no payload bytes, cartridge byte values, file names or paths
A08 (pure finder, no trace): on the generator's own screens, the true table is among the top five candidates for every development seed (decoys can tie without a trace)
Live editor set up before any experiment: an authored cartridge running, a frame in the library, the default project
Isolation: the sandbox is a byte-identical copy of this build (its document SHA-256 equals the file's), in an opaque origin that cannot reach the editor's storage or document

A01: in the sandbox runner only the valid scoped variant runs (its SHA-256 equals an independently patched copy); header, vector, past-the-end, duplicate, wrong-expected and trainer mutations end as invalid; the base is unchanged after every trial and the fixture files are untouched

A02: two cold runs and two runs restored from an in-sandbox checkpoint give identical state, frames and ordered bus events; the same-value control has no effect; a checkpoint is not restored once another load replaced its machine
A02: a variant cannot start from the base cartridge's checkpoint (incompatible state refused)

A04 (NROM): every opcode-fetch byte is an instruction start and every operand byte lies inside an instruction (checked against the generator's own listing); the one dual-use byte is both; drawn table bytes are data reads made through the $8000 mirror of the single 16 KiB PRG while code runs at $C000; NMI vector bytes are vector reads; the never-taken IRQ vector, the decoys and other untouched bytes stay unknown

A07 (NROM): PPU writes are logged in order with their mapped addresses (the first screen's 960 nametable writes equal the generator's nametable; attribute writes made through the cartridge's mirror land at $23C0–$23FF; the $3F10 write lands on palette 0); watched RAM writes carry the writing instruction
A07: at the event cap the trace is marked truncated and incomplete, and the receipt says absence is not evidence; observing is passive (a traced run and an untraced run give identical state)

A05: a RAM-only change with unchanged pixels and a palette change with an unchanged nametable are both detected per channel; a change that only shows in the third screen diverges after frame 120 and leaves the first two captures equal; a cartridge that never enables rendering is "target not reached", not "no effect"

A03: a data mutation shows its effect; a code mutation that traps the CPU in a loop is capped and classified as a timeout (stuck program); an engine exception in the sandbox is a crash; a cancelled trial stops at the next chunk; the following baseline is identical to the earlier one
A03: removing the sandbox mid-trial ends the trial as cancelled within a moment, leaves no sandbox frame behind and leaves the base unchanged

A10: two different interventions with identical screens share one stored payload per screen but keep their own causal edges; the palette variant shares the nametable payload yet is a distinct observation; re-importing the private export adds nothing

A08/A09 development seeds (7): blind discovery finds each table (rank ≤ 5 before testing, the tested survivor is the true table, every tested decoy falsified, controls without effect); the frozen definition reconstructs the withheld screen with no wrong block ID and every stated attribute bit right, judged by the independent oracle
A08/A09 withheld seeds (5: one acceptance seed and four generalization seeds, never run while the discovery code was built): the same, judged by the same oracle

A15: a deliberately broken definition (table shifted by one record) reconstructs identically every time on the same engine, yet the independent oracle rejects it; the true definition passes. Repeatability is reported as repeatability only

A16 (intake): a candidate definition offered to the library's pack registration, library import or investigation import is refused, the library is unchanged, and no experiment command can promote or register anything

Panel: only the synthetic demonstration is offered (no cartridge picker); it runs to a candidate, tested first-ranked table, and says that independent verification is not performed in the editor; its metadata export holds no payload bytes or paths
The live project, the editor's emulator state and cartridge, the resource library and the browser databases are exactly as before every experiment; no sandbox is left open
Offline: no network request left file:// during the whole run
No uncaught page errors

A01.note: header, trainer, PRG/CHR bounds, vector, plan-protected, duplicate and wrong-expected mutations; the base SHA-256 is re-checked after every trial (success, rejection, timeout, soft and hard cancel); the crash case is an engine exception inside the sandbox, which never holds the base

A02.note: cold ×2 and checkpoint-restored ×2 identical incl. ordered bus events; same-value control; incompatible checkpoint refused

A03.note: data effect, stuck-CPU timeout, sandbox crash, soft and hard cancellation, unaffected follow-up baseline

A04.note: NROM portion: opcode/operand/data/dual-use/vector/unvisited roles and the $8000/$C000 mirror. Banked fixtures (identical CPU addresses resolving differently): DEFERRED to slice 2

A05.note: RAM-only and palette-only differences, delayed first divergence, target not reached kept apart from no effect

A06.note: bounded: in-sandbox checkpoints refuse another cartridge or a replaced machine. Corrupted exported checkpoints and worker interruption/restart: DEFERRED (no checkpoint leaves the sandbox in this slice; worker job kind is BL08)

A07.note: NROM portion: mirrored nametable and palette writes, watched RAM, passive observation, cap and truncation. CHR-RAM and bank-switch events: DEFERRED (NROM CHR-ROM fixture)

A08.note: 2x2 interleaved and split-array tables in both quadrant orders, decoys and aliases, 12 seeds incl. 5 withheld. 4x4, other strides beyond split arrays: DEFERRED

A09.note: held-out screen reconstructed exactly (IDs and attribute bits), unknown and ambiguous kept explicit. Partial scroll and dynamic CHR: DEFERRED

A10.note: payload deduplication with separate causal edges, palette distinction, idempotent import, tampered payload and receipt refused

A12.note: collision and object fields (BL10): later scope

A14.note: valid/invalid/adversarial plans, unsupported kinds, budget limits; trials run in declared order; explicit states

A15.note: independent oracle (generator data, no shared code) rejects a broken definition that repeats perfectly on the same engine. Second emulator: DEFERRED (BL12)

A16.note: tampered receipts/candidates refused; candidates cannot be marked verified; library intake refuses them; metadata export without bytes or paths; no promotion path exists

A17.note: worker experiment endpoints (BL08): later scope. The existing worker security suite (agent-lab-worker) still runs in the full regression

A18.note: standalone from file:// without the worker, no network, editor state unchanged, timer lateness measured; the full regression is a separate receipt. Worker-paired portion: DEFERRED
